# TASK-143 — specification

## Scope

Specification as an interactive chat: the Build with AI conversation is a guided interview that asks one question at a time as a card with the control that fits it (text, chips, yes/no, slider, grid, table dialog), saves the person's own answer at once, folds into a question and answer bubble, and offers skip, unknown, not applicable and "Suggest with AI"; wrap-ups for skipped, unknown and optional questions, then readiness; jump from the document; works without any model.

## Notes

A local AG-UI agent (`interview-agent.ts`) plays the interview through CopilotKit and hands typed messages and suggestions to the AI; a suggestion becomes a proposal for that one question. Tests: `tests/interview.test.ts`, `interview-agent.test.tsx`, `question-card.test.tsx`, `QuestionCard.stories.tsx`, `e2e/interview.spec.ts`. Verified in the browser with a real local model. Found and fixed: CopilotKit clears the agent's messages when the chat mounts; an answer bubble with white text on a tinted background; unnamed CopilotKit icon buttons.
